# MouthHealthy

> > MouthHealthy is the American Dental Association's trusted resource for evidence-based oral health information, education, and guidance across all life stages.

MouthHealthy, powered by the ADA (American Dental Association), provides comprehensive dental care guidance, educational resources, and consumer information on topics ranging from daily oral hygiene to specialized care for different age groups and populations. The site emphasizes the ADA Seal of Acceptance and connects users to dentist directories, insurance guidance, and preventive health strategies.

## Core Navigation

- [MouthHealthy Homepage](https://www.mouthhealthy.org): ADA's MouthHealthy homepage for comprehensive oral health information
- [All Topics A-Z](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z): A-Z index directory of dental topics and oral health information
- [Resources](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/resources): Central hub for oral health resources, educational materials, and awareness

## Daily Dental Care

- [Daily Routine](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/daily-routine): Guide to daily dental routine: brushing, flossing, and oral care basics
- [Nutrition's Impact](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/nutritions-impact): Nutrition guide for oral health: diet, sugar reduction, and tooth erosion
- [Foods That Damage Your Teeth](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/nutrition/9-foods-that-damage-your-teeth): Guide to nine foods that damage teeth and cause enamel erosion
- [Nicotine Use](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/nicotine-use): Information on nicotine, smoking, vaping effects on oral health

## Life Stages & Specialized Care

- [Babies and Kids](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/life-stages/babies-and-kids): Pediatric dental guide: baby teeth care, fluoride, cavity prevention
- [Teens](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/life-stages/teens): Teen dental guide: orthodontics, wisdom teeth, sports mouthguards
- [Adults](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/life-stages/adults): Dental care guide for adults: tooth decay, implants, and dry mouth
- [Pregnancy](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/life-stages/pregnancy): Prenatal dental health guide: oral care, nutrition, and pregnancy concerns
- [Patients with Special Needs](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/patients-with-special-needs): Dental care guide for patients with special needs and disabilities

## Dental Visits & Professional Care

- [Seeing the Dentist](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/seeing-the-dentist): Guide to finding dentists, dental visits, and managing dental anxiety
- [Paying for Care](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/paying-for-care): Resources for dental insurance, payment options, and affordable care

## Education & Teaching Resources

- [Lesson Plans](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/resources/lesson-plans): Teaching resources and worksheets for classroom dental health education
- [Dental Health Demonstrations](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/resources/lesson-plans/demonstrations): Educational demonstrations and lesson plans for teaching dental health

## Optional

- [Dental Trends](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/dental-care/dental-trends): Consumer education on dental trends, myths, and teeth whitening facts
